crossRefs.note: The man did as Joseph commanded, and the man brought the men to Joseph’s house.

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: The man did as Joseph commanded, and the man brought the men to Joseph’s house.
translations.bsb: The man did as Joseph had commanded and took the brothers to Joseph’s house.
translations.kjv: And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men into Joseph's house.
translations.asv: And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men to Joseph's house.
